docs.title: Introduction to Data Security Practicum
docs.text: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the security and privacy of machine learning systems. You will learn to attack, defend, and audit AI models through practical labs organized into 8 thematic modules.

docs.title: Instructors & Staff
docs.text:
• Instructor: Prof. Lendák Imre
  • Teaching Assistant: Ahmed F. Lagha

docs.title: Lab Curriculum
docs.text: Module Lab Topic Notebook 1. Foundations 1 DNN Training & Robust Model Baselines 2. Input Manipulation 2 Evasion Attacks (FGSM, PGD) 3. Data Poisoning 3a Label Flipping Attacks 3b Backdoor & Trigger Injection 4. Model Poisoning 4a Model Trojans & Supply Chain Attacks 4b Trojan Detection & Certified Defenses 5. Availability 5a Sponge Attacks & Resource Exhaustion 5b Sponge Attack Defenses 6. Confidentiality 6a Membership Inference Attacks 6b Model Inversion & Feature Reconstruction 7. Synthetic Data 7 Tabular Synthetic Data (VAE, GAN) 8. Defenses 8a Differential Privacy & DP-SGD 8b Federated Learning & Adversarial Training

docs.title: Learning Outcomes
docs.text: Skill Description Understand Fundamental concepts of machine-learning security and privacy Implement State-of-the-art attacks (Evasion, Poisoning, Inversion) in PyTorch Evaluate Model robustness using quantitative metrics and certified bounds Design Multi-layered defense strategies (DP, FL, Robust Training) for production Generate Privacy-preserving synthetic data for sensitive domains (healthcare, finance)

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This module covers the foundational aspects of deep neural network (DNN) training and establishes robust model baselines.

docs.title: Lab 1: DNN Training & Robust Model Baselines
docs.text:
In this lab, you will learn how to train a basic DNN and evaluate its performance against standard baselines.

  • View Notebook on GitHub

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Focuses on evasion attacks, specifically targeting the input data to deceive machine learning models.

docs.title: Lab 2: Evasion Attacks (FGSM, PGD)
docs.text:
Explore Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM) and Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) attacks.

  • View Notebook on GitHub

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Examines how training data can be manipulated to compromise model integrity.

docs.title: Lab 3a: Label Flipping Attacks
docs.text:
Learn how flipping labels in the training set can degrade model performance.

  • View Notebook on GitHub

docs.title: Lab 3b: Backdoor & Trigger Injection
docs.text:
Implement backdoor attacks where a specific trigger in the input causes the model to misbehave.

  • View Notebook on GitHub

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Investigates attacks that target the model directly, often through supply chain vulnerabilities.

docs.title: Lab 4a: Model Trojans & Supply Chain Attacks
docs.text:
Analyze how Trojans can be embedded in pre-trained models.

  • View Notebook on GitHub

docs.title: Lab 4b: Trojan Detection & Certified Defenses
docs.text:
Methods for detecting Trojans and implementing certified defenses.

  • View Notebook on GitHub

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Covers attacks designed to exhaust system resources and reduce model availability.

docs.title: Lab 5a: Sponge Attacks & Resource Exhaustion
docs.text:
Learn how sponge attacks can increase the energy consumption or latency of inference.

  • View Notebook on GitHub

docs.title: Lab 5b: Sponge Attack Defenses
docs.text:
Strategies for defending against resource exhaustion attacks.

  • View Notebook on GitHub

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Explores attacks that aim to leak sensitive information from the model or its training data.

docs.title: Lab 6a: Membership Inference Attacks
docs.text:
Determine if a specific data point was used during model training.

  • View Notebook on GitHub

docs.title: Lab 6b: Model Inversion & Feature Reconstruction
docs.text:
Reconstruct sensitive features or training data from model predictions.

  • View Notebook on GitHub

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Methods for generating privacy-preserving synthetic data.

docs.title: Lab 7: Tabular Synthetic Data (VAE, GAN)
docs.text:
Generate synthetic tabular data using Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs).

  • View Notebook on GitHub

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Comprehensive strategies for defending machine learning models.

docs.title: Lab 8a: Differential Privacy & DP-SGD
docs.text:
Implement Differential Privacy using DP-SGD.

docs.text:
Explore Federated Learning and robust adversarial training techniques.
